scope.reason: The first release is deliberately narrower than all Mindmake Shorts. Scope expansion still needs the normal cross-job evidence and a separate approval.

confirmed_inference: Krish likes immediately legible promises, concrete scenes, visible progression and scripts that keep changing the audience's mental model. He rejects exaggerated adjectives, removed qualifiers, unsupported causality, arbitrary punch-ins, generic technology B-roll, all-caps word-by-word captions, mid-video follow requests and empty comment CTAs. Mindmake Shorts should lead with receipts, trace one mechanism, treat the countercase fairly and finish with a hard earned verdict.
capture_boundary: This is a minimal Git release record for an explicitly approved change. It does not claim that the surrounding chat was captured as a tracked portable Studio session.
